VAR CurrentTradeSales = [Trade Sales]
VAR PreviousTradeSales = [Trade Sales PY]
VAR PercentageChange =
    IF(

        DIVIDE(CurrentTradeSales - PreviousTradeSales, ABS(PreviousTradeSales)),
        BLANK()
    )
RETURN

Time Periods can be used with Anchor Date, Anchor Month, Anchor Month Number, and Anchor Week End Date if a user wants to create a specific “as of” time period. Anchor Date definition may change depending on the fact selected. Snapshot Facts: Anchor Date is the date the snapshot was taken. Example: Open Orders Snapshot with an Anchor Date selection of 6/7/2021, the data represents what Open Orders were on 6/7/2021. Non-Snapshot Facts: Anchor Date is the last date of transactions included in the time period selected. Example: Invoice Sales with an Anchor Date selection of 6/7/2021, the data represents what shipped on or before 6/7/2021 for the time period selected.
